verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized dashboard as a centralized hub for updates and documents, a Compliance Calendar with annual-report deadline reminders, real-time compliance-status notifications from state filing offices, and license-expiration alerts. Nothing shows these combined into one portfolio view listing every entity and state registration with its standing, so the core multi-entity dashboard is unproven. Missing for 10: documented multi-entity/multi-state portfolio view, per-registration good-standing display in the dashboard, consolidated deadline view across entities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
